title: Trigonometric Functions: the Effect of k and p
seo_title: Grade 11 Trigonometric Functions Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Investigate the effect of the parameter k on the graphs of y = sin(kx), y = cos(kx) and y = tan(kx); investigate the effect of the parameter p on the graphs of y = sin(x + p), y = cos(x + p) and y = tan(x + p); draw sketch graphs.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 11 worksheets: graphs of y = sin kx, cos kx, tan kx and y = sin(x + p), cos(x + p), periods, shifts and maximum points. 100 questions with memos.
key_sub: x + p moves the graph left.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • k changes the period: 360° ÷ k for sin and cos, 180° ÷ k for tan.
  • p moves the graph sideways: x + 30° moves it 30° to the left; x − 30° moves it 30° to the right.
  • To find y, work out the angle first, then the ratio.
  • a and q still change the amplitude and move the graph up or down.

Examples

Example

y = cos(x − 60°)

max when x − 60° = 0°

Answer: x = 60°

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
× kThe period is 360° ÷ k.
The direction+ p moves left.
The angleWork out x + p first.
